//: SessionStart is ON by default: refetches the studio marketplace in the
background at session start, so the NEXT local session you open is
current. It cannot update the session it runs in — agents and commands
register before hooks fire. This is a no-op in cloud sessions (they
install fresh from main at every session start already, and 'claude' is
not a command available to run from inside one).
hooks.example.json documents an additional, still-opt-in SessionEnd nudge.

hooks.command: command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 && (claude plugin marketplace update claude-code-studio >/dev/null 2>&1 &) ; exit 0
